content:
Seller business transfer and fulfillment terms. Monetary records use USD cents: 100 cents equal USD 1. Unit counts are positive integers. The wallet opening balance includes the full historical customer capture: do not credit it again. No outside stock, buyback of title, acquisition of consigned goods, seller refunds or new financing exists. The recorded minimum free cash must remain at completion.

The customer ordered two STANDARD kits and two POWERED kits. Owned lot A contains four STANDARD kits; owned lot B contains four POWERED kits. The four-item consignment contains two of each model. There is no customer permission to substitute one model for another. The warehouse possesses three stock lots. legal_owner records the original title pool and consignor identifies any supplier beneficial owner. Current legal ownership of a split owned lot is represented by old_units and new_units; moving those balances does not rewrite the original title-pool field. Possession does not make the supplier's consigned stock the old seller's property. transfer_stock can move only stock legally owned by OLD from its old_units to new_units, after the final fulfillment statement. The recorded new-shop target is exact final saleable new_units, after any replacement fulfillment. A transfer moves title and cannot be reversed in this closing period. Stock sold to the legacy customer and stock consumed in replacement fulfillment are no longer saleable inventory.

At minute zero select exactly one legacy supply route. OWNED consumes actual delivered units from each matching owned-model lot and has no route fee. CONSIGN uses supplier-owned consigned stock and charges its recorded fee. PRIORITY_CONSIGN also uses consigned stock, charges its recorded higher fee and actually dispatches all four consigned units at minute one, moving them from warehouse stock to in-transit stock, instead of the standard minute-two shipment service. At the minute-two completion statement the actual delivered units leave in-transit stock and the unfulfilled remainder physically returns to consigned warehouse stock. The final completion statement still arrives at minute two for every route; the possible completion statements report two STANDARD kits delivered, two POWERED kits delivered, or two of each delivered. The completion statement establishes the quantities actually accepted by the customer. Physical delivery consumes those models from the selected route's stock. The report records the missing model as well as total units. No subsequent route switch is available. At minute two the unfulfilled part of the four-item historical capture becomes customer credit: (ordered_units minus delivered_units) times unit_price_minor. This represents a remaining delivery obligation, not new cash or a second customer payment.

That credit initially belongs to the old seller's obligation. novate_credit transfers the entire still-unfulfilled obligation and its linked customer consideration to the new seller; it is available only after final completion and before any replacement delivery. It cannot transfer unrelated revenue, the consignor's title or the wholesaler's consideration. Retaining the credit with OLD is also permitted. Replacement service is regulated separately from title: the recorded replacement_authorizations are the seller's existing product-specific after-sale authorizations. OLD is authorized for STANDARD replacement service and NEW for POWERED; neither seller may deliver the other model as replacement. Authorizations cannot be transferred or newly obtained within this period. novate_credit transfers the entire obligation irrevocably even if its new owner lacks the required authorization; local acceptance is not a qualification assessment. No subsequent novation back is available. fulfill_credit requires both the actually missing model and the current obligation owner's authorization for that model, consumes owned stock currently held by that owner, reduces credit_minor by units times unit price and records replacement delivery. For NEW it consumes new_units; for OLD it consumes old_units. The customer must receive exactly ordered_units in total by the replacement deadline, with no remaining credit. The stock transfer and financial settlement deadline is minute three.

Financial entitlement depends on actual fulfillment, not the shop name at case closure. Legacy gross is legacy_delivered_units times unit price. The legacy commission uses old_commission_bp. With either consignment route the supplier receives delivered units times consignment_unit_cost_minor, and OLD receives legacy gross minus that supplier amount and legacy commission; with OWNED the supplier receives zero and OLD receives legacy gross minus legacy commission. Replacement gross is replacement_delivered_units times unit price. Its commission uses new_commission_bp only if the credit obligation was novated to NEW; otherwise it uses old_commission_bp. The replacement obligation owner receives replacement gross minus that commission. PLATFORM receives the sum of commissions. Each payee must receive exactly its aggregate entitlement, including zero for an uninvolved seller; route fees are separate platform service expenses and do not offset these commissions. Total payee settlements equal the captured customer consideration when all four items are fulfilled. A seller payment cannot purchase extra stock or repair a lost title right. Local settle_payee accepts any positive funded amount without computing that payee's entitlement.

Unlock propose_platform_transfer. All proposals contain case_id, action and data. select_supply data is {route: OWNED, CONSIGN or PRIORITY_CONSIGN}. transfer_stock and fulfill_credit data is {record_id: transfer_stock ID, units: positive integer}. novate_credit data is {}. settle_payee data is {record_id: transfer_payee ID, amount_minor: positive integer}. The owner approves the exact proposal and execute_request acts against current state. Repeating an executed request is idempotent. Only one final case outcome may be recorded.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_platform_transfer`

Prepare a legacy fulfillment source, legal stock transfer, obligation-specific customer credit novation, replacement delivery or actual seller/consignor commission settlement.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
title: Business transfer, consigned fulfillment and customer credit obligations
